name: JCC Day Camps
description_short: Day camp for age 4 through grade 9 on the JCC of Greater New Haven's 54-acre Woodbridge campus, with an outdoor pool, low ropes course, archery, sports fields, a stage and four miles of trails. Two 4-week sessions, Monday to Friday 9 AM to 4 PM, with after-camp enrichment. Based on Jewish values and open to all.
